supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: visible extension of the ridge beyond the lateral canthus of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: low contrast; consistent dark pixel intensity across the muzzle, cheeks, and periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate vertical thickness with a visible lateral droop in the lower lip

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: superior helix is folded or notched, creating an atypical pointed silhouette

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: structural deformity/collapse of the upper quadrant of the pinna
other_distinctive_markers: extensive white and grey hair distribution across the chin and lower muzzle (beard)
